title: A Song For You
original_lyrics:
[intro]
+
I've been so many places in my life and time
I've sung lot of songs, I've made some bad rhyme
I've acted out my life in stages, with ten thousand people watching

[bridge]
+
I know your image of me is what I hope to be
I've treated you unkindly but baby can't you see
There's no one more important to me, baby can't you please see through me,
'Cause we're alone now and I'm singin' this song for you.
You taught me precious secrets of the truth, withholdin' nothin'
You came out in front and I was hiding

[bridge]
Listen to the melody 'cause my love's in there, hiding
+
I love you in place where there's no space or time;
I love you for my life, you are friend of mine,
And when my life is over, remember when we were together
We were alone and I was singin' this song for you.
You taught me precious secrets of the truth, withholdin' nothin'
You came out in front and I was hiding

[bridge]
Listen to the melody 'cause my love's in there, hiding
We were alone and I was singin' this song for you
We were alone and I was singin' this song, singin' this song for you
